descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Open World Racing: Cyberpunk City is an immersive open-world racing game built specifically for virtual reality on Meta Quest. Step into a futuristic cyberpunk metropolis where glowing neon lights, towering skyscrapers, and reflective rain-covered streets surround you in full VR presence.

Experience high-speed driving from a true first-person cockpit perspective and feel the scale of the city around you. With gameplay optimized for comfort and immersion in VR, players can cruise freely through the city or push their limits with fast-paced street racing and drifting mechanics.

The world is fully explorable, featuring wide highways, dense urban districts, and hidden routes waiting to be discovered. Realistic lighting, dynamic reflections, and cyberpunk-inspired visuals create a deep sense of atmosphere and presence inside the headset.

Drive through the city at your own pace, enjoy the neon skyline, or master drifting through tight corners and long streets designed for high-speed exploration.

Current Features

• Open-world cyberpunk city designed for VR
• Full in-car cockpit driving controls for immersive gameplay
• High-speed racing and drifting mechanics
• Realistic lighting, neon reflections, and atmospheric environments
• Comfortable VR gameplay optimized for Meta Quest
